f_cee31d9391.name: l3_s30_spread
f_cee31d9391.hypothesis: A station with multiple sub-operations can leave a part with one measurement far from the others when a fixture or tool drifts, so the within-station numeric spread should widen on bad parts.
f_cee31d9391.sql:
SELECT Id,
       CASE WHEN L3_S30_F3494 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3499 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3504 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3509 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3514 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3519 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3524 IS NULL OR L3_S30_F3529 IS NULL
            THEN NULL
            ELSE greatest(L3_S30_F3494, L3_S30_F3499, L3_S30_F3504, L3_S30_F3509, L3_S30_F3514, L3_S30_F3519, L3_S30_F3524, L3_S30_F3529) -
                 least(L3_S30_F3494, L3_S30_F3499, L3_S30_F3504, L3_S30_F3509, L3_S30_F3514, L3_S30_F3519, L3_S30_F3524, L3_S30_F3529)
       END AS l3_s30_spread
FROM parts_numeric

f_883bbeed75.name: l3_s35_normspread
f_883bbeed75.hypothesis: A station with several parallel gauges can show failure when one gauge departs from the others; normalizing the spread by the number of observed gauges helps distinguish a real process upset from a generally sparse readout.
f_883bbeed75.sql:
SELECT Id,
       CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3884 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3889 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3894 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3896 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3898 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3903 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3908 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3913 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (greatest(L3_S35_F3884, L3_S35_F3889, L3_S35_F3894, L3_S35_F3896, L3_S35_F3898, L3_S35_F3903, L3_S35_F3908, L3_S35_F3913) -
                  least(L3_S35_F3884, L3_S35_F3889, L3_S35_F3894, L3_S35_F3896, L3_S35_F3898, L3_S35_F3903, L3_S35_F3908, L3_S35_F3913)) /
                 (CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3884 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3889 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3894 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3896 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3898 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3903 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3908 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                  CASE WHEN L3_S35_F3913 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       END AS l3_s35_normspread
FROM parts_numeric
